findings.evidence: Line 32 `public structure IntervalPartition (n : ℕ)`; the public theorems at lines 603/623/637/645/663 name no `IntervalPartition` in their types. PR description asserts it is 'now non-public'.
findings.fix: Drop `public` from `public structure IntervalPartition`, matching the rest of the (already non-public) tube scaffold.
findings.issue: `IntervalPartition` is proof-local partition scaffolding but is exposed with `public structure`. It appears in no public signature; only non-public helper theorems reference it. This is the api-design round-4 over-exposure the PR claims to have fixed.

findings.evidence: Line 58 `public structure TubeData (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ)`; `Path.exists_isOpen_mem_subset_setOf_homotopic` (line 603) uses `T_data`/`toSet`/`isOpen` internally but returns `∃ T : Set (Path x y), ...` with no `TubeData` in its type.
findings.issue: `TubeData` is proof-local tube data but is exposed with `public structure`. It is constructed/consumed only by non-public theorems (`exists_pathHomotopyTrivial_tube`, `TubeData.toSet`, `TubeData.isOpen`, `tube_subset_homotopy_class`) and appears in no public signature.

summary: The proof-local tube scaffolding structures `IntervalPartition` and `TubeData` are still declared `public`, contradicting the PR description's claim that they were made module-private. They are internal tube-argument data appearing in no public product signature.
